migrationNotes: Second HHH Campaign 2 release and the eighth HHH Core Case, produced against the released Case 07 baseline 337b6b23acb39b0df3bba248315839901c4a2eba and the approved Blueprint.

Owner-approved printable baseline: a3bbb0388cdb4233500fcfd4deadc8c939a7426e. The owner reviewed that byte set on screen and completed physical print review of it, stating: "Approved, including physical print review complete and approved." The owner supplied no browser, printer, print scale, paper or colour mode and none is claimed anywhere in this release. Release conversion changed no printable source: content.html, presentation.css and layout-overrides.json are byte-identical to that commit, and only task-registry.js moved, to carry the lifecycle stamp, which renders nothing.

Certified release-source commit: the release-conversion commit recorded in the pins above. The released task-registry.js bytes first exist at release conversion, because the lifecycle stamp is created by release conversion, so the pins identify that commit rather than the owner printable baseline. This is proven by walking every commit in the feature range and testing the full released four-file byte set at each, not assumed. The two are recorded separately and deliberately, following the Case 03, Case 04, Case 05, Case 06 and Case 07 precedent.

No owner-approved bundle exists and none is claimed. The release-history schema requires no bundle field. A git bundle was produced during the original implementation report, but it covered the pre-remediation candidate 00f21423fdaf781be5e418b749369ad22d950b47 rather than the approved baseline, and there is no evidence the owner inspected or approved any bundle file.

Two linear commits, zero merges, each independently reviewed before the next was authorised. 00f21423fdaf781be5e418b749369ad22d950b47 was the original candidate; the full independent review returned CASE08_REMEDIATION_REQUIRED on five findings while passing the lesson architecture itself. a3bbb0388cdb4233500fcfd4deadc8c939a7426e was the bounded remediation child closing all five, and the re-review returned CASE08_REMEDIATION_REVIEW_PASS.

The five remediated findings. F1 MAJOR: the H3 lakeshore-settlement claim was true of the Library of Congress plate but was not declared in sourceCertification, and six identical marks in one straight row did not visually agree with it; the plate was independently reopened, two directly observed relationships were added to the case-local certification, the refusals were widened to cover any settlement number, position, spacing, extent, shoreline geometry or distance, and the shore is now drawn as seven short grouped runs of unequal length at uneven positions. F2 MAJOR: the H3 figure contract forbade the drawing from containing a visible causeway count while requiring a causeway drawing, which no finite drawing can satisfy; the contract was corrected to say what it meant, the guard was widened from accessibility text to printed figure text and all role prose, and the cardinal cross was replaced by four connectors at uneven lengths and uneven non-cardinal bearings. F3 MODERATE: three documents claimed the Accessible edition receives selected figure labels; the figures are intentionally identical and the claim was removed everywhere without inventing a replacement. F4 MINOR: the H8 extended description named an arrow the figure does not draw and now describes the upward soil-renewal cue it does. F5 MINOR: Teacher page 7 said three published sources above a four-source table and now says four, while the separate and still-correct three-real-world-source-cards statement is retained and disambiguated.

The exact commit the owner approved was independently confirmed after approval with no modifications - the post-owner confirmation was read-only and changed no bytes - and no commit existed after the owner-approved printable baseline before release conversion began. Final independent disposition: INDEPENDENT_CASE08_POST_OWNER_PASS - READY_FOR_RELEASE_CONVERSION.

Frozen game-source baseline: d9fc16baf272cb543c29cbd0c06ec85efad60be8. The Phase 1 audit baseline remains 9b8545ed6ecf98b337326390400076e36789e056, and the audit record of reference is hhh/audit/HHH_MASTER_GAME_AUDIT_v0.1.md against the approved Blueprint hhh/blueprint/HHH_CURRICULUM_BLUEPRINT_v1.0.md.
Runtime case identity: C2 L1, The Floating Gardens, Tenochtitlan in 1487. instructionalType CORE_CASE.

The game finding HHH-GAME-C2L1-001 is classified CURRICULUM_QUALIFICATION_REQUIRED, not a blocker. No game remediation was required or requested and the shared remediation dependency tracker is untouched; it remains OPEN_AT_AUDITED_GAME_BASELINE, which is correct for a teacher-qualification dependency the curriculum carries. Both halves of the qualification are taught: "floating gardens" is a conventional nickname and chinampas are raised fields built up in shallow water on a staked structure set into the lake bottom, and the opposite overcorrection is refused as firmly - the packet prints INAH's record of the severe flood of 1604 and the four later rebuildings of the same causeway.

Eight visible tasks carry the Core Case spine, and the culminating product is an Engineered Landscape Explanation rather than canonical CER. CER is declined on the Blueprint ground Cases 06 and 07 established: the explanation keeps an accurate definition, two evidentiary links from different real-world sources, a geographic connection, one explicit source qualification and a synthesis as six separately scored parts, which a single-claim frame cannot hold. No role renders the shared canonical CER component and no role declares a CER contract.

Task 2 is deliberately non-keyable. It records a provisional geographic test taken before the explanatory sources arrive, there is no correct answer, and the Answer Key omits it without renumbering while stating on its first page that it is not keyed. The Teacher Guide carries the guidance for reading it diagnostically, and no learner page states any grading policy.

Complete in-packet no-game dossier: all four required reconstructed strands - the farmer at the plots, the plot soil, the lake works and the harvest count - plus the buried collapse account that Task 6 tests by name. Campaign 2 has no level selector and no direct-launch mode, so every assessed piece of evidence exists in the learner packet and the Teacher Guide supplies both a gameplay route and a complete no-game route.

Source estate: four certified real-world sources carried on three learner cards. Phase 1 source H12, the FAO GIAHS chinampas file, is reused exactly as the audit certified it and the frozen audit is not modified. Three sources are certified case-locally and bounded in sourceCertification: INAH's bulletin of 9 January 2024 on Arqueologia Mexicana no. 184, INAH's Albarradon de San Cristobal record, and the Library of Congress copy of Cortes's second letter published at Nuremberg in 1524. The hydraulic-works entry expressly refuses to certify the game's reconstructed east-and-west lake arrangement, and no historical, agricultural, hydrological, chronological, quantitative or archaeological claim appears anywhere in the package that is not on one of those bounded lists.

The H3 figure is an ADAPTED FROM redraw rather than a reproduction of the plate, and that deviation from the stated preference is recorded and justified in the package README for the PMO: the repository has never held a raster binary, the plate is a hand-coloured conquest-era woodcut whose framing is an owner call, and print legibility in grayscale is better served by the redraw. No imagery of any kind is used anywhere in the package beyond the shared institutional insignia.

Standards: three directly assessed - C3 D2.His.1.6-8, C3 D3.2.6-8 and CCSS RH.6-8.7 - and two supporting, CCSS RH.6-8.9 and CCSS WHST.6-8.2. RH.6-8.9 is deliberately held at supporting because no task asks the learner to analyse the relationship between a primary and a secondary source. No NGSS performance expectation is claimed at any status, not even Contextual.

Declared Accessible adaptations: exactly four, and no fifth. The map setting supplied in Task 3, one modelled figure relationship in Task 4, and a modelled row plus one prefilled cell in Task 5. Both figures are identical in the two editions and the Accessible edition supplies no figure label the Student edition lacks. Edition parity is enforced structurally through editionResponseContract across 24 subparts, with accessible-only prohibited.

Regression protection retained by the release: three closed-class semantic guards - chinampas do not float, reconstructed game material is not surviving 1487 evidence, and the 1524 plan is not an exact 1487 map - each paired with a positive structural requirement and shipping sixteen negative and sixteen positive controls plus two exemption mutation controls; the two bounded enumeration guards for schematic connectors and shoreline settlements; the four-band source-status contract; the two-layer evidence separation in Task 6; the Task 7 multi-source and source-qualification requirements; the case-local source certification bounds; task-reference parity; the edition response contract; the standards lock at exact list equality; page identity; persistent response controls; and HTML-only enforcement.

Visible learner provenance follows shared/visual-style-guide/amendments/STUDENT_FACING_METADATA_AND_VISUAL_HIERARCHY_v1.0.1.md. Every learner-visible band uses exactly four controlled forms - SOURCE STATUS followed by RECONSTRUCTED GAME EVIDENCE, DOCUMENTED, HISTORICAL MAP or CURRICULUM-ORIGINAL SCHEMATIC - while the machine-readable evidence-layer markup is unchanged and is what validation binds to.

This release claims no SSS legacy exemption. It is a full current-contract release with frozen Student, Teacher and Answer Key DOM baselines; the Accessible DOM hash was additionally computed and compared at both trees to prove parity across all four roles.
